author: piztanza
description: Restructure (F-001): move Team, Early Adaptors, and Investors off the landing page onto their own routes /team, /early-adaptors, /investors (nav + footer + metadata + sitemap), remove them from the / stack, and rewire all nav links and CTAs accordingly (hero 'For investors' → /investors, 'Join Early Adaptor Program' → /early-adaptors; anchors on non-landing pages become /#... links). Copy and i18n unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: /team, /early-adaptors, /investors render the existing section content with sticky nav + footer, approved copy, working EN/ID toggle, own metadata (pipe titles) and sitemap entries
Landing / no longer contains those three sections; remaining band order intact with no layout gaps
Nav links point to the new routes from every page; problem/how-it-works/why-mobeeli anchors resolve correctly from non-landing pages via /#id
Hero CTAs: 'Join Early Adaptor Program' → /early-adaptors; 'For investors' → /investors; /early-adaptors CTA → /join
Suite green with updated landing test + new per-page tests
